note: The release names its payload growth here in the release commit, before its final build (docs/BUILD_OUTPUT.md "Size ledger"): version = the release (X.Y.Z), reason = why a payload folder grew past the margin against the previous release. Used by the size guard when a build is given no --size-growth-reason.
reason: Bloodmoon's Solstheim is new in v0.0.68: its 153 cells in a CHIM store and maps of their own, the Mortrag Glacier's ice, the werewolf bodies, and the open sea between Vvardenfell and Solstheim (982 cells, about 27 MB, the far sea in a store of its own); the growth of 'other' (+0.18 GiB in the v0.0.68-dev12 build) is that content
